title: review: H5a fix round 2: a fresh codex() on a task that already carries a result refuses to claim and start unless the task is running; post_tool_result never overwrites an existing result without merged_into and thread checks; the test exercises the real bus.claim path (review T-0376)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain 2de1126 (T-0358) and 4968f53 (T-0371) in git log; never drop or amend them.
Review T-0376 on T-0371, one high finding:
1. executor.start calls bus.claim(task_id, "codex", worktree) unconditionally before post_tool_result runs, flipping any task, even one done or merged, to running while its old result stays; a second codex(task_id, prompt) (Planner retry after a dropped MCP response) then passes post_tool_result's guard (previous is not None and status != running is False) and silently overwrites commit, thread, rounds and provenance with no previous_commits entry and no merged_into check. test_codex_fresh_thread_does_not_overwrite_done_task passes only because it mocks executor.start.
Fix: (a) executor.start (or mcp.codex before it) refuses to claim a task whose status is done or whose merged_into is set and which already has a result: return {status: refused, reason: "task <id> already has a result from thread <thread>; use codex_reply for a fix round"} without touching the bus; only a queued or running task (or a done task with no result) may be claimed. (b) post_tool_result: the overwrite guard checks merged_into is null and, for a fresh thread, that no result exists, independent of status; codex_reply's replace path keeps recording previous_commits and rounds. (c) Rewrite test_codex_fresh_thread_does_not_overwrite_done_task to drive the real code path: create a done task with a result on the sandbox bus, call the mcp codex tool with executor._run (the subprocess) mocked but bus.claim and post_tool_result real, and assert the result, status and thread are unchanged and the reply says refused. Add test_codex_reply_on_merged_task_is_refused.
Keep the T-0358 and T-0371 tests and every existing test green. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows 4968f53 and 2de1126 below your commit

tests/test_mcp.py::test_codex_fresh_thread_does_not_overwrite_done_task drives the real bus.claim and post_tool_result path (executor.start is not mocked) and passes; ::test_codex_reply_on_merged_task_is_refused passes
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

comments.issue: post_tool_result/start/reply use check-then-act on the bus (read status/result, then later write) with no lock. Two concurrent tool calls on the same task_id could both pass the not-yet-posted check before either writes, double-posting/racing. Not exercised by current sequential planner usage or the new tests, so low severity, but worth a note.
